newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Maghreb trade unions condemn European task force.
newsitem.headline: Maghreb trade unions condemn European task force.

text.p: North African trade union organisations on Thursday condemned the setting up of an intervention force known as Eurofor announced last month by four European countries.

"We condemn this initiative which is considered as a dircet and clear threat to the Arab Maghreb countries, an attempt to interfere in their (internal) affairs and a threat to their security and stability," they said in a statement.

The statement was issued at the end of an emergency meeting on Thursday of representatives of the main trade unions from Algeria, Libya, Morocco, Mauritania and Tunisia at their Tunis-based coordination bureau called Arab Maghreb Trade Unions Union.
Eurofor was set up by France, Italy, Spain and Portugal who said it was to be used for peacekeeping and humanitarian missions in conflicts.
The force will be able to call on up to 10,000 troops for use and has its command headquarters in Florence, Italy.
It will be made available to the 10-nation Western Europeasn Union and can also be put at the disposal of NATO and the United Nations, the countries involved have said.
"This is new colonialism," the North African trade unions said.
